T: Steal the Declaration. Then have lunch.
D: A treasure hunter finds a map on the back of the Declaration of Independence and has to steal it first.
P: Serve the snacks when Ben brushes lemon juice on the back of the Declaration.
S: Grilled lemon oregano chicken pieces on toothpicks, lemon mayo to dip
Chicken thigh pieces marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled until charred, served on toothpicks with lemon aioli.
Soft figure-eight pretzels with rock salt, butter and yellow mustard

Pretzels shaped into figure eights, boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with yellow mustard. Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into figure eights, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, brush with butter and serve with yellow mustard.
the old ship buried in the Arctic ice

Creamy chowder of bacon, potato, onion and clams finished with cream and thyme, served in small cups with oyster crackers on top. Steam 1kg clams in 250ml water in a covered pot for 5 minutes until open, then pick out the meat and strain the liquid. Fry 150g diced bacon, add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and soften. Add 500g diced potatoes, the clam liquid and 500ml milk, and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream, the clams and thyme, and season. Serve in cups with oyster crackers.
M: Shaved rib eye with onion and melted provolone on long rolls

Rib eye frozen 30 minutes, shaved thin, seared with onions, provolone melted over, piled into long rolls. Freeze a 600g rib eye steak for 30 minutes, then shave it paper thin. Fry 2 sliced onions in oil until soft, add the beef and sear fast on high heat. Lay provolone over the top to melt and pile into split long bread rolls.
Founding Fathers chicken and leek pot pie

Chicken, leek and mushroom in a creamy thyme sauce, baked under a golden puff pastry lid, with buttered peas on the side. Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then remove. Soften 2 sliced leeks and 200g mushrooms in 40g butter, stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml chicken stock and 150ml cream. Simmer until thick, add thyme and the chicken, and season. Pour into a pie dish, top with a puff pastry sheet, brush with egg and cut a slit. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with 400g buttered peas.
W: Frozen lemon ice scraped fluffy with a fork as it freezes

Sharp, smooth lemon water ice scraped into paper cups, the Philadelphia corner-stand favourite, with a few fresh raspberries on top. Boil 750ml water with 250g caster sugar until dissolved, then cool. Stir in 250ml lemon juice and the zest of 2 lemons. Pour into a shallow metal tray and freeze for 4 hours, scraping and stirring with a fork every 45 minutes so it stays smooth and fine. Blitz briefly in a food processor just before serving, scoop into cups and top with raspberries.
K: Invisible ink lemon, ginger and mint fizz
Lemon, ginger syrup and muddled mint over crushed ice, topped with soda water

Fresh lemon juice shaken with ginger syrup and mint, topped with soda over crushed ice, sharp enough to bring a map to light. Simmer 150g caster sugar, 150ml water and a 5cm piece of sliced ginger for 5 minutes, then cool and strain. In a jug, muddle a big handful of mint with 200ml lemon juice and the ginger syrup. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, pour in the lemon mix and top with 800ml chilled soda water. Garnish with lemon wheels and mint sprigs.
